name: San Ilia King
source:
Peter the Fourteenth is the King San Ilia. An old, “wise” man, he has high praise and respect for Goddess Ilias, only accepting heroes who have received her blessings to meet him (although Luka was an exception). 

[Edited from [url=https://mgq.miraheze.org/wiki/San_Ilia_King]Mon-musu Quest Wiki[/url]]
